title: Colleen Hoopes death (May 20, 2022) - Christopher Hoopes station interview recordings

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Arizona Public Records Law, A.R.S. § 39-121 et seq., I hereby request the following records:

Records related to the May 20, 2022 shooting death of Colleen Hoopes at the couple's home in Tempe (Christopher Hoopes pleaded guilty to negligent homicide on November 16, 2026):
1. All audio/video recordings of interviews of Christopher Hoopes by Tempe Police detectives at the police station.

I request that the records be provided electronically (download link or file transfer). Please release all reasonably segregable non-exempt portions; if any record or portion is withheld, please cite the specific statutory exemption.

If the fees for this request are expected to exceed $50, please send me an itemized estimate before processing the request.

Thank you in advance for your cooperation. I look forward to receiving your response within the time required by law.

Sincerely,

Pavel Paponov
